prompt: Create one vertical 2:3 cinematic photographic portrait of a distinct new fictional, clearly adult East Asian woman, age 22, quietly gathering her hair with both hands behind her head. Give her a petite, light adult frame with moderately narrow relaxed shoulders, natural adult head-to-shoulder proportions and naturally full covered curves. Preserve the specific raised-arm silhouette, ivory cropped camisole and loose ivory drawstring skirt, a narrow strip of midriff, fine layered necklaces, and warm directional light falling into deep soft-edged shadow. Her adult face is calm and partly obscured by the lighting, not uniformly illuminated. This portrait should feel like a private, unhurried everyday gesture, with strong photographic structure and no exaggerated posing.  Twelve linked composition facts: (1) The vertical frame includes the raised elbows, crown, torso and upper thighs, with the woman filling most of the frame. (2) Both elbows point upward and outward while the hands gather long hair behind the head; most fingers remain naturally hidden by hair. (3) Her torso turns slightly in three-quarter view with a gentle waist and hip shift, and the face angles a little toward the viewer and down. (4) Warm dark-brown hair is loosely lifted at the back with a wispy irregular fringe and a few strands around the forehead; a long curling tail falls behind the image-right shoulder. (5) The adult softly oval face has calm gently parted lips and eyes partly concealed in directional shadow. (6) A fitted ivory cropped camisole has slender straps, curved seamed cup construction and a gathered center tie. (7) A small strip of midriff separates the cropped hem from a loosely gathered ivory drawstring skirt. (8) Fine layered gold chains, including a small pendant, lie across the upper chest. (9) Warm light from upper image left catches the outer left arm, cheek edge, neckline and fabric while the opposite arm and parts of the torso stay dark. (10) The background is a plain muted olive-gray wall with a lighter lower-left area and darker upper field. (11) Natural full covered chest volume flows into a compact adult waist without making the shoulders, back or ribcage large. (12) Keep the intimate shadow-led mood, simple environment and natural hair-gathering gesture, with no added props or forced smile.  Adult facial character and hair: Create an independent new adult individual, with a softly oval face, natural cheek volume and gently rounded chin. Use softly shaped brows, moderately sized dark eyes under relaxed lids, a small smooth nose with a natural tip, and gently full lips in a muted warm rose tone. The mouth is slightly open in a resting expression, without a pout or smile. Keep her gaze quiet near the camera, partially veiled by shadow; do not brighten both eyes just to make them readable. The facial geometry should suit a restrained East Asian beauty editorial aesthetic, described by these visible forms rather than a generic template. Avoid sharply carved cheekbones, an exaggerated tall angular nose, enlarged eyes, deep artificial eye sockets, plastic skin or childlike proportions. Use delicate skin microtexture and light makeup, allowing warm lit skin and darker shaded skin to remain distinct.  The hair is long, medium-to-dark warm brown, lifted loosely behind the crown by both hands. The top has a small soft messy mound, an irregular part and loose short fringe strands over the forehead, with fine flyaways catching the light. Several longer strands escape near the temples and neck. A long section falls behind the image-right upper arm and shoulder, ending in loose curved tips near the side of the torso. Keep this hair-gathering gesture candid, without converting it into a polished updo, neat ballet bun, short bob or flower-adorned hairstyle. No large ornaments or invented accessories in the hair.  Clothing, adult proportions and fabric: The ivory camisole is cropped just above the waist. It has thin matching shoulder straps and rounded supportive seamed panels over the bust, with small gathers and a short delicate tie at the center of the neckline. The fabric is soft, matte, lightly textured and opaque over intimate anatomy, with subtle wrinkles produced by the raised arms and fitted waist. Preserve the small center gather, curved seams and slightly uneven soft hem rather than replacing the top with a deep-V gown, plain sports tank or rigid corset. Naturally full covered chest volume is defined by fabric tension and light, not inflated anatomy or a broad ribcage. Keep a compact adult torso, a softly tapered waist and light arms. Do not flatten the body, exaggerate the bust, over-constrict the waist, or broaden the shoulders and back to create fullness. A narrow strip of natural midriff is visible above the skirt. The ivory skirt sits at the waist with a softly gathered elastic or drawstring edge; thin strings hang down the front. Its loosely flowing fabric falls in vertical folds toward the bottom edge of the portrait. Keep any delicate translucency confined to loose outer fabric, with intimate areas securely covered. No exposed intimate details, extra cutouts or decorative lingerie additions.  Pose and anatomical continuity: Both arms lift above shoulder height and bend at the elbows, framing the head without a symmetrical bodybuilding pose. One elbow extends toward upper image left; the other reaches higher toward upper image right. The hands are positioned behind the head, working gently in the hair, and need not be revealed if obscured. Keep plausible upper-arm lengths, elbow bends and shoulder joints. The raised arms lengthen the torso naturally; the shoulders remain light and not thick or muscular. The chest, waist and hip lines form a quiet flowing curve through a slight three-quarter turn. The head tilts subtly down and toward the viewer. Preserve the adult head-to-shoulder ratio, avoid extreme shoulder narrowing or an elongated neck, and do not pull back to show the feet. Maintain a close portrait camera distance with a natural short-telephoto impression and no wide-angle stretching.  Light, wall and mood: Use a strong warm directional source from upper image left, as if late light is entering a quiet room. It creates a rim and bright plane along the outside of the left raised arm, loose hair strands, part of the cheek, collarbone, and the left-facing folds of the ivory top and skirt. Let much of the forehead, eyes, image-right arm and central torso remain in rich warm shadow, with enough restrained reflected light to retain their shape. Preserve a soft transition at shadow edges and the three-dimensional rounded fabric rather than flattening everything with frontal fill. The plain olive-gray wall is slightly brighter in the lower-left region and darker above; it is unadorned and subordinate. Keep the palette warm ivory, muted brown, olive-gray and amber skin highlights. No cold white skin, colorful gels, flash, room decor, text or location markers. The emotional focus is the pause while tying the hair, the lifted-arm silhouette and the quiet face in shadow.  Finish in native vertical 2:3 without upscaling. Reorganize the small amount of peripheral wall space to keep both elbows, the head and the central garment structure within the frame; do not stretch the body or enlarge the room. Use fine photographic grain, gently rolled highlights and light editorial retouching that preserves adult anatomy and skin microtexture. Verify the arms, shoulder joints, neckline seams, midriff and skirt ties. Do not invent visible fingers where the hair conceals the hands. No text, watermark, logos, borders or interface marks.
